title: Sidney Bechet's playing and standing in France
summary: Mike McKendrick was with Eddie South; Bechet led his own band, played clarinet and sax, and was beloved in France.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Sidney Bechet: the man, the horn, the legend

blocks.x: Was Sidney working with the band? Were they together in the same band?
No, no. Mike was with Eddie South.
Oh, yes.

Eddie South's band. Eddie South was over there. You know who Sidney was playing with? No, with him. He played mostly with the white band, with the white fellas. Some of the French? Yeah, the French, yeah.
